# moshlabs Provider

Mosh Labs system-context primitives (account/environment/service scoping) as native Terraform data sources instead of nested modules.

The provider takes no configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    moshlabs = {
      source  = "moshlabsdotnet/moshlabs"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

# The provider takes no configuration.
provider "moshlabs" {}
```
